blocks.prompt: 5 Given the function \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x},\ x \ne 0\). Find the equation of the transformed function after applying the following transformations in order. Horizontal shift 2 units to the left, horizontal compression by factor 2, vertical stretching by factor 3, and vertical shift 1 unit upward.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein chaar transformations hain aur un ki tarteeb (order) di gayi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Chaaron tabdeeliyon ke baad aakhri function.
Rule: 2 baayen = \(x\) ki jagah \(x + 2\); 2 se horizontal compression = \(x\) ki jagah \(2x\); 3 se vertical stretch = poore ko 3 se zarb; 1 oopar = poore mein 1 jama.
Plan: har qadam sab se naye function par, aur har nateeje ka naam rakhte jayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\).
Maloom karna: chaar transformations di gayi tarteeb mein lagane ke baad function.
Tareeqa: baayen shift \(y = f(x + 2)\); compression \(y = g(2x)\); stretch \(y = 3h(x)\); oopar shift: 1 jama. Pehli do andar (\(x\) par) ki tabdeeliyan hain, aakhri do bahar (\(y\) par) ki.

Qadam 1: 2 units baayen
\[g_{1}(x) = f(x + 2) = \dfrac{1}{x + 2}\]
Kyun: baayen ka matlab \(h = -2\), aur \(x - (-2) = x + 2\). \(f\) mein jahan \(x\) tha wahan \(x + 2\) rakh diya.
Dhyan dein: baayen ke liye plus aata hai, minus nahin.

Qadam 2: 2 se horizontal compression
\[g_{2}(x) = g_{1}(2x) = \dfrac{1}{2x + 2}\]
Kyun: \(y = g(bx)\) mein \(b = 2 > 1\) graph ko 2 guna dabata hai. \(g_{1}\) ke har \(x\) ki jagah \(2x\) rakha, is liye \(x + 2\) ban gaya \(2x + 2\).
Dhyan dein: \(2(x + 2) = 2x + 4\) likhna ghalat hai; sirf \(x\) badalta hai, poora bracket nahin.

Qadam 3: 3 se vertical stretch
\[g_{3}(x) = 3g_{2}(x) = \dfrac{3}{2x + 2}\]
Kyun: \(y = af(x)\) mein \(a = 3\) har output ko teen guna karta hai; poora fraction 3 se zarb hua, is liye 3 numerator mein aaya.

Qadam 4: 1 unit oopar
\[y = \dfrac{3}{2x + 2} + 1\]
\[= \dfrac{3 + 2x + 2}{2x + 2}\]
\[= \dfrac{2x + 5}{2x + 2}\]
Kyun: oopar jane ke liye har output mein 1 jama kiya. 1 ko \(\frac{2x + 2}{2x + 2}\) likh kar ek fraction bana diya.

Tasdeeq:
\(\frac{1}{x}\) ka point \((1, 1)\) follow karein: 2 baayen \(\to (-1, 1)\); compression \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, 1\right)\); stretch \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, 3\right)\); 1 oopar \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, 4\right)\).
\[\dfrac{2(-\frac{1}{2}) + 5}{2(-\frac{1}{2}) + 2} = \dfrac{4}{1} = 4\]
Bilkul sahi. \(\frac{1}{x}\) ke asymptotes \(x = 0\) aur \(y = 0\) bhi ab \(x = -1\) aur \(y = 1\) ban gaye.
